model.note: Part outlines are traced from Toro's studio photo (US model shown; the club's unit is 30931ANZ) and are approximate. The picking unit, wheels, wheel motors, battery and electrical box sit underneath and are in the parts list. Part numbers come from parts catalog 3474-206 and operator's manual 3472-861. The serial was not supplied: read the plate.

base.name: Lower housing
base.desc: Lower housing over the picking unit and wheels. Wet weather, daily: stop, tip the robot onto its rear, switch off and clear mud and grass off the wheels and picking unit with a blower, compressed air or wire brush. Never use solvents. 6-monthly: check the wiring under the robot; dealer if damaged.

body.name: Body shell
body.desc: Main shell. Wipe with a damp cloth; never solvents. Through the season keep all screws, nuts and bolts tight. Robot weighs 85 kg; maximum slope 30%; tilt cut-out above 41 degrees.

archL.name: Rear wheel arch, left
archL.desc: Covers the left rear drive wheel. Keep mud and grass off the rear wheels (wire brush every 40 h, daily in wet weather).

archR.name: Rear wheel arch, right
archR.desc: Covers the right rear drive wheel. Keep mud and grass off the rear wheels (wire brush every 40 h, daily in wet weather).

sidepanel.name: Side panel
sidepanel.desc: Side panel carrying the charge contacts.

cover.name: Top cover
cover.desc: Ribbed top cover. Wipe with a damp cloth; never solvents. Status, alarms, schedules, maps and battery cycles are read in the Toro Turf Pro portal (turfpro.toro.com) and Connect app; there is no hour counter described in the manual.

stop.name: Stop button cover
stop.desc: Red STOP cover. Press it before lifting, tipping or cleaning the robot, then switch off.

sonar.name: Ultrasonic (sonar) sensors
sonar.desc: Four sonar sensors 164-0084 per robot. Every 40 h: remove mud and grass and wipe with a damp cloth; no water. Catalogue row combines the bumper kit 164-0086 with the sensor.

contacts.name: Charge contacts
contacts.desc: Every 40 h: rub with 280-grit sandpaper until clean. Check the robot docks and charges each day and the app shows no alarms.

bumper.name: Bumper
bumper.desc: Bumper kit 164-0086. Every 40 h: check for cuts and tears; clean with a damp cloth only, no water.

picker.name: Picking unit: picker wheels and rods
picker.desc: Picker wheel shaft 163-5774 with four rods 163-5775; picker handles 163-5777 RH and 163-5778 LH. Picking width 956 mm. Every 40 h (best practice, not in the OEM schedule): check the shaft and rods for wedged balls, bent rods or debris. Average 15,600 balls a day (maximum 19,500).

rake.name: Front rake and grid
rake.desc: Front rake 163-5737 and grid 163-5742 with three rubber pads 163-5740. Every 40 h (best practice): check for damage and wedged balls.

deflectors.name: Golf ball deflectors
deflectors.desc: Four deflectors 163-5667 per robot. Every 40 h (best practice): check for damage.

basket.name: Basket, ball counter and full-basket detector
basket.desc: Basket holds 320-350 balls. Ball counter sensor 163-5762; basket linear actuator 163-5763. Every 40 h (best practice): full-basket detector and ball counter sensor clean, basket latches working. Daily: check the basket empties and the drop-pit flows. Maximum two robots per drop-pit station.

frontwheels.name: Front wheels (x5)
frontwheels.desc: Five front wheels 163-5501 on front hub assembly 163-5497. Every 40 h: clean them; they must spin freely without excess play, replace if loose. Clean and inspect the front wheel axle.

rearwheels.name: Rear wheels (x2)
rearwheels.desc: Rear tyre 163-5491 (rear wheel assembly 163-5560), two per robot. Every 40 h: wire-brush off mud and grass.

motors.name: Wheel motors (x2)
motors.desc: Wheel motor 163-5683 (slope), two per robot; gearbox gasket 164-2981. No lubricants are specified by Toro.

battery.name: Battery, LiFePO4
battery.desc: Battery 164-0085: LiFePO4 25.6 V, 19.2 Ah, 491.5 Wh, with heater battery kit 163-5819 (heater contacts 163-5818). Do not open. About 240 min work per charge, 80 min minimum to full. The robot manages its own cycles: if cycles look short in the portal, the dealer checks the battery. Storage: fully charge, switch off, clean, store dry and frost-free, cover the charging station. Back into service: switch on, power to the station, check battery voltage, start and confirm it returns to the station. Same battery number as the Turf Pro 500.

fuses.name: Fuses (electrical box)
fuses.desc: Mini blade fuses in the electrical box: 121-8864 (5 A) and 121-8867 (15 A).

wiring.name: Wiring under the robot
wiring.desc: 6-monthly: check the wiring under the robot; dealer if any damage. Yearly service by an authorised Toro technician.

rtk.name: RTK base, station and boundary wire
rtk.desc: Shared with the Turf Pro 500: 4G RTK base 30912ANZ, charging and drop-pit station and boundary wire. Toro's parts lookup lists a Busy Loop Kit 163-3924 (Range Pro) and Surge Protector Kit 163-3925; the surge kit is worth fitting on an exposed range.

163-5818.note: Part of the heater battery kit.
